title: From 3AM Crash to a Golden Morning Reset
caption:
It's 3AM. The screen dies. Then the sun rises.
Hands race over a glowing keyboard until a red system error wipes the screen to black, then sunrise slowly floods the desk and the monitor wakes to a clear blue sky.
Loop it and watch the darkness melt into warm morning light.
Would you keep working after a 3AM crash or call it a night?
Save this for your next late-night reset.
